title: playbook show --json
description: One playbook family after every member's edits are applied in topological order: parents before children, team files before user files, then by stem.

path.description: Team files read through a checkout are relative to its root (.agents/playbooks/<file>); every other path is absolute.

status.description: skipped when the repo has no .agents/playbooks or it holds a broken link.

lines.description: pstack's check-playbooks.mjs output, verbatim, or the reason it did not run.

stem.description: A playbook file's stem: a bundled playbook's, a team file's or a user file's.

kind.description: pstack for a bundled playbook, team for a file in the checkout's .agents/playbooks, user for a file in the config dir.

playbook.description: The family's root: a bundled playbook or a standalone one.

asked.description: The stem the command named. It differs from playbook when that stem is a member of the family.

repo.description: Repo key: the name part of the origin remote, or the --repo value. null outside a repo.

owner.description: Owner part of the origin remote. null when unknown.

org.description: The config.json orgs entry that owns the repo. null when none does.

pstack.description: pstack version the bundled playbooks came from, from the plugin manifest or a folder named like a version. null when neither gives one.

family.description: The root, then each active member, in apply order.

text.description: The step with every edit applied and replaced text removed. Step N is index N-1.

origin.description: The stem of the file that wrote the step.

kind.description: The kind of the file that wrote the step.

touched.description: Stems of the other files that edited the step with In or Replace, in apply order.

overrides.description: Each In or Replace on a step that a different file wrote, by step, then in apply order.

file.description: The file that made the edit.

origin.description: The file that wrote the step.

after.description: Files that edited the step earlier in apply order. Absent when none did.

handoffs.description: Each other family the steps or notes hand off to, named by its root, in order of first mention. Only references that resolve to an active playbook appear; check reports the rest.

playbook.description: Root of the family handed off to. Show it too.

steps.description: Steps that name it, ascending. Empty when only notes do.

inNotes.description: true when a note names it.

problems.description: Validator findings in the family's files, files that extend a member, every file with an extends no context defines, and every broken link.
